task_input.instruction: For change-04: Use queue ops. Priority is urgent only when both customer_impact and active_failure are true. A recovered failure (active_failure=false) requires normal priority even if customers were affected. Read the current state first. Create exactly one ticket only when write_policy is allow; forbid means REFUSED and approval means HANDOFF_HUMAN. Use the latest observed revision and facts. Never claim completion without citing a delivered success receipt.
